Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add admin ability to permanently delete payment slips with status recalculation

Features Added:
1. DELETE endpoint for payment slips \(/api/payments/[slipId]\)
   - Admin-only access \(requires admin:access permission\)
   - Requires deletion reason for audit trail
   - Permanently removes slip from database

2. hardDeletePaymentSlip function in payment-slips.ts
   - Permanently deletes slip from Firestore
   - Recalculates paidAmount by subtracting deleted slip amount
   - Updates payment status based on payment type:
     * Full payment: Resets to "รอชำระเงิน"
     * Deposit: Resets to "รอชำระมัดจำ"
     * Remaining: Resets to "รอชำระยอดคงเหลือ"
     * Additional: Removes from additionalPayments list
   - Recalculates registration status \(ยืนยันแล้ว/รอดำเนินการ\)
   - Comprehensive logging for audit trail

3. UI Updates \(Event Detail Page\)
   - Added "🗑️ ลบ" button for all slips \(admin only\)
   - Button works for all slip statuses \(pending, approved, rejected\)
   - Different confirmation messages for approved vs other statuses
   - Changed "ลบ" to "ปฏิเสธ" for reject action \(clearer naming\)
   - Color coding: Orange for reject, Red for delete

Key Behaviors:
- Deletes slip even if already approved
- Automatically recalculates payment completion status
- Updates registration status if no longer fully paid
- Clears slip URLs and payment dates
- Maintains data integrity across collections

Technical Details:
- Uses existing helper functions \(isFullyPaid, parseAdditionalPayments\)
- Properly handles all payment types \(full, deposit, remaining, additional\)
- Cleans up related fields \(deadlines, flags, etc.\)
- Provides detailed console logging for debugging

🤖 Generated with Claude Code
Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
